question: Where are a restaurant situated within 20 kilometers when moving northwest from AHN Cancer Institute, Erie, PA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%AHN Cancer Institute%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS origin WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry :: geography, origin.geometry :: geography, 20000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
